name: The Birthday
source:
This is an otome game with routes for Inazuma Eleven's Fubuki and Hiroto. 

The protagonist (name customizable) is representing Japan at the FFI World League Cup. 
Fubuki and Hiroto need a third to perfect their new killer combo. 
At first the protagonist doesn't have much interest, but as he gets to know the boys, his attitude changes... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE109624.html]DLsite English[/url]]
